        FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchID1, ',', ';')) S
        INNER JOIN #UserAllowedBranch UA ON LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) = UA.BranchID
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(S.value, ''))) <> '';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID) SELECT BranchID FROM #UserAllowedBranch;
    END




    DECLARE @NamBC INT, @ThangBC INT;

    IF LEN(@PeriodID) >= 6
    BEGIN
        SET @NamBC = CAST(LEFT(@PeriodID, 4) AS INT);
        SET @ThangBC = CAST(SUBSTRING(@PeriodID, 5, 2) AS INT);
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @NamBC = YEAR(GETDATE());
        SET @ThangBC = MONTH(GETDATE());
    END;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Tầng bung chi tiết từ bảng DETAIL
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH BungDonNghi_CTE AS (
        SELECT
            M.PersonID,
            ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(DT.HinhThucNghi)), '') AS HinhThucNghi,
            M.StatusID,
            DATEADD(DAY, V.number, CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE)) AS NgayThucTe,
            ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1) AS TongSoNgayNghiThuong,
            CEILING(ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1)) AS SoDongDuKien
        FROM dbo.HR_NghiPhepTbl M
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_NghiPhepDetailTbl DT ON M.DocumentID = DT.DocumentID
        JOIN master..spt_values V ON V.type = 'P' AND V.number < CEILING(ISNULL(DT.SoNgayNghi, 1))
        WHERE ISNULL(M.IsXinHuy, 0) = 0
          AND YEAR(CAST(DT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE)) = @NamBC
    ),

    PhanLoaiNgayNghi_CTE AS (
        SELECT
            B.PersonID,
            B.NgayThucTe,
            MONTH(B.NgayThucTe) AS ThangNghi,
            B.HinhThucNghi,
            -- Thử việc (1), Chính thức (2), Đã duyệt (8) đều ghi nhận lên bảng 12 tháng
            CAST(CASE
                WHEN B.StatusID IN (1, 2, 8) AND B.SoDongDuKien > 0 AND B.HinhThucNghi <> 'HH'
                    THEN B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong / B.SoDongDuKien
                ELSE 0
            END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS GiaTriPhanBoPhep,

            CAST(CASE
                WHEN B.StatusID IN (1, 2, 8) AND B.SoDongDuKien > 0 AND B.HinhThucNghi = 'HH'
                    THEN B.TongSoNgayNghiThuong / B.SoDongDuKien
                ELSE 0
            END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS CongNghiThucTe
        FROM BungDonNghi_CTE B
    ),

    MonthlyLeave_CTE AS (
        SELECT
            PersonID,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 1  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T1,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 2  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T2,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 3  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T3,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 4  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T4,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 5  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T5,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 6  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T6,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 7  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T7,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 8  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T8,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 9  THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T9,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 10 THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T10,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 11 THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T11,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi = 12 THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS T12,

            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi <= @ThangBC THEN GiaTriPhanBoPhep ELSE 0 END) AS DaSuDungDenThang,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ThangNghi <= @ThangBC THEN CongNghiThucTe ELSE 0 END) AS HieuHi
        FROM PhanLoaiNgayNghi_CTE
        GROUP BY PersonID
    )

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Tầng xuất dữ liệu khớp 100% thứ tự cột bảng Excel mẫu
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        -- Cột 1, 2, 3: Thông tin nhân viên
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PE.PersonID) AS TT,
        PE.PersonName AS HoVaTen,
        PE.ChucDanhChuyenMon AS ChucDanh,

        -- Cột 4 đến 15: Chi tiết từ Tháng 1 đến Tháng 12
        ISNULL(m.T1, 0) AS M1,
        ISNULL(m.T2, 0) AS M2,
        ISNULL(m.T3, 0) AS M3,
        ISNULL(m.T4, 0) AS M4,
        ISNULL(m.T5, 0) AS M5,
        ISNULL(m.T6, 0) AS M6,
        ISNULL(m.T7, 0) AS M7,
        ISNULL(m.T8, 0) AS M8,
        ISNULL(m.T9, 0) AS M9,
        ISNULL(m.T10, 0) AS M10,
        ISNULL(m.T11, 0) AS M11,
        ISNULL(m.T12, 0) AS M12,

        -- Cột 16: Còn phép năm 2025 chuyển qua tính đến hết quý 1/2026
        ISNULL(p.PhepTonNamTruoc, 0) AS PhepTonNamTruoc,

        -- Cột 17: Phép năm 2026 (đến tháng 04) -> Lấy số ngày tiêu chuẩn + ngày cộng thêm nhập tay
      --  (ISNULL(p.SoNgay, 0) + ISNULL(p.SoNgayPhepTet, 0)) AS QuyPhepNamNay,

        -- Cột 18: Phép Thâm niên/năm
        ISNULL(p.PhepThamNien, 0) AS PhepThamNien,

        -- Cột 19: Ngày tết âm lịch 2026 (đưa vào phép) do đi làm
        ISNULL(p.SoNgayPhepTet, 0) AS PhepTetAmLichDiLam,

        -- Cột 20: Hiếu, hỷ
        ISNULL(m.HieuHi, 0) AS HieuHi,

        -- Cột 21: Tổng phép = Phép tồn gốc + Phép năm + Phép thêm + Thâm niên + Phép làm Tết
        (ISNULL(p.PhepTonNamTruoc, 0) + ISNULL(p.SoNgay, 0) + ISNULL(p.SoNgayPhepTet, 0) + ISNULL(p.PhepThamNien, 0)) AS TongPhep,

        -- Cột 22: Phép đã sử dụng trong năm 2026 (Tổng từ các đơn tháng)
        ISNULL(m.DaSuDungDenThang, 0) AS PhepDaSuDungDenThang,

        -- Cột 23: Phép còn lại năm 2026 = Tổng quỹ phép trừ đi số ngày đã nghỉ thực tế
        ((ISNULL(p.PhepTonNamTruoc, 0) + ISNULL(p.SoNgay, 0) + ISNULL(p.SoNgayPhepTet, 0) + ISNULL(p.PhepThamNien, 0)) - ISNULL(m.DaSuDungDenThang, 0)) AS PhepConLai,

        -- Cột 24: Ghi chú
        ISNULL(p.GhiChu, N'') AS GhiChu

        --Cột 25 : Phép tết

    FROM dbo.HR_PersonTbl PE
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonNghiPhepTbl p ON PE.PersonID = p.PersonID AND p.Nam = @NamBC
    LEFT JOIN MonthlyLeave_CTE m ON PE.PersonID = m.PersonID

    WHERE (@BranchID1 = '' OR @BranchID1 = 'ALL' OR PE.BranchID = @BranchID1);
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_BaoCaoNhansu2ReportStp]
@Template varchar(50),
@FromDate datetime ,
@ToDate datetime,
 @BranchID1 NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
 , @User VARCHAR(50) = ''



As
Begin
Set nocount on
    DECLARE @BranchString NVARCHAR(MAX);

SELECT @BranchString = BranchID
FROM SY_User
WHERE UserName = @User;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Person;
CREATE TABLE #Person
(
    PersonID NVARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY
);

INSERT INTO #Person(PersonID)
SELECT P.PersonID
FROM HR_PersonTbl P
WHERE P.PersonStatus = 4
AND
(
    ISNULL(@BranchString,'') = ''
    OR EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BranchString, ',') S
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) = P.BranchID
    )
);

    DECLARE @SoLuongTang INT,
            @SoLuongGiam INT;

    -- Số lượng tăng trong kỳ
    SELECT @SoLuongTang = COUNT(*)
    FROM HR_PersonTbl
    WHERE NgayVaoLam >= @FromDate
      AND NgayVaoLam < DATEADD(DAY,1,@ToDate)
      AND @BranchID1 = ''  OR BranchID IN ( SELECT value FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchID1, ',', ';')));

    -- Số lượng giảm trong kỳ
    SELECT @SoLuongGiam = COUNT(*)
    FROM HR_PersonTbl
    WHERE NgayNghiViec >= @FromDate
      AND PersonStatus = '8'
      AND @BranchID1 = ''  OR BranchID IN ( SELECT value FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchID1, ',', ';')));

    -- Dữ liệu báo cáo
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Data;

SELECT
    P.STT,
    P.PersonID,
    P.PersonName,
    P.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
    P.NgaySinh,
    P.TitleName,
    P.CMND,
    P.CMNDNgayCap,
    P.CMNDNoiCap,
    N'CHI NHÁNH: '+ P.BranchID AS BranchID,
    P.LoaiHD,
    HD.DanhSachHopDong,
    HD.NgayKyMoiNhat,
    HD.MucDong,
    P.DiaChiThuongTru,
    P.SocialID,
    P.SocialDate,

    CAST(CASE
            WHEN HD.NgayKyMoiNhat >= @FromDate
             AND HD.NgayKyMoiNhat < DATEADD(DAY,1,@ToDate)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
         END AS BIT) AS NhanVienMoi,

    CAST(CASE
            WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl CT
                INNER JOIN HR_BaoHiemTbl BH
                    ON BH.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID
                WHERE CT.PersonID = P.PersonID
            )
            THEN 0 ELSE 1
         END AS BIT) AS ThieuBaoHiem,


CAST(CASE
        WHEN HD.PersonID IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
     END AS BIT) AS ThieuHD,

    @SoLuongTang AS SoLuongTang,
    @SoLuongGiam AS SoLuongGiam

INTO #Data

FROM HR_PersonView P
INNER JOIN #Person T
    ON T.PersonID = P.PersonID

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        H1.PersonID,
        MAX(H1.NgayKyHopDong) AS NgayKyMoiNhat,
        MAX(H1.MucDong) AS MucDong,
        STUFF((
            SELECT CHAR(13)+CHAR(10)+H2.MaHopDong
            FROM HR_HopDongTbl H2
            WHERE H2.PersonID = H1.PersonID
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
        ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'),1,2,'') AS DanhSachHopDong
    FROM HR_HopDongTbl H1
    GROUP BY H1.PersonID
) HD
ON P.PersonID = HD.PersonID


WHERE
  (@BranchID1 = '' OR P.BranchID IN (SELECT value FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchID1,',',';'))) )

IF @Template='HR_BaoCaoNhanSuNVNReport'
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    FROM #Data
    WHERE LoaiHD='NVN';
END
ELSE IF @Template='HR_BaoCaoNhanSuNNNReport'
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    FROM #Data
    WHERE LoaiHD='NNN';
END
ELSE IF @Template='HR_BaoCaoNhanSuThieuHDReport'
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    FROM #Data
    WHERE ThieuHD=1;
END
ELSE IF @Template='HR_BaoCaoNhanSuThieuBHReport'
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    FROM #Data
    WHERE ThieuBaoHiem=1;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    FROM #Data;
END
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_BaoCaoNhanSuReportStp]
    @FromDate    datetime = NULL, -- Gán mặc định bằng NULL (rỗng)
    @ToDate      datetime = NULL, -- Gán mặc định bằng NULL (rỗng)
    @PhongBan    nvarchar(50) = N''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        -- Thông tin định danh
        P.PersonID          AS [Mã nhân viên],
        P.PersonName        AS [Họ Tên],
        P.GioiTinh          AS [Giới tính],
        P.NgaySinh          AS [Ngày sinh],
        DATEDIFF(YEAR, P.NgaySinh, GETDATE()) -
            CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, P.NgaySinh, GETDATE()), P.NgaySinh) > GETDATE()
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [Tuổi],

        -- Liên hệ & Địa chỉ
        P.CMND              AS [Số CCCD/CMND],
        P.CMNDNgayCap       AS [Ngày cấp],
        P.CMNDNoiCap        AS [Nơi cấp],
        P.DienThoai         AS [Điện thoại],
        P.Email             AS [Email],
        P.DiaChiThuongTru   AS [Địa chỉ thường trú],
        P.DiaChiHienNay     AS [Địa chỉ hiện nay],

        -- Công việc & Phòng ban
        P.PhongBan          AS [Bộ phận],
        D.TenPhongBan       AS [Tên bộ phận],
        ISNULL(LS.TitleName, P.TitleName)     AS [Chức vụ],
        ISNULL(LS.PostionName, P.PostionName) AS [Vị trí],

        -- Thời gian làm việc
        P.NgayVaoLam        AS [Ngày vào làm],
        P.NgayThuViec       AS [Ngày thử việc],
        P.NgayNghiViec      AS [Ngày nghỉ việc],
        PS.PersonStatusName AS [Trạng thái],
        DATEDIFF(MONTH, P.NgayVaoLam, ISNULL(P.NgayNghiViec, GETDATE())) AS [Thâm niên (Tháng)],

        -- Hợp đồng & Lương
        P.SoHopDong         AS [Số hợp đồng],
        P.LoaiHopDong       AS [Loại hợp đồng],
        P.NgayHopDong       AS [Ngày ký HĐ],
        P.NgayHetHopDong    AS [Ngày hết hạn HĐ],
        HD.LuongCoBan       AS [Lương cơ bản HĐ],

        -- Bảo hiểm & Ngân hàng
        P.SocialID          AS [Số sổ BHXH],
        P.SocialDate        AS [Ngày cấp BHXH],
        P.SoTheBHYT         AS [Số thẻ BHYT],
        P.BankName          AS [Ngân hàng],
        P.BankAccountNo     AS [Số tài khoản],
        P.BankHolder        AS [Chủ tài khoản],

        -- Học vấn
        P.EducationName     AS [Trình độ học vấn],
        P.CareerName        AS [Ngành nghề],
        P.JobName           AS [Công việc chính]

    FROM HR_PersonTbl P
    LEFT JOIN HR_DepartmentListTbl D ON D.PhongBan = P.PhongBan
    LEFT Join HR_PersonStatusTbl PS ON PS.PersonStatus = P.PersonStatus
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT PersonID, LuongCoBan,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PersonID ORDER BY NgayKyHopDong DESC) as rn
        FROM HR_HopDongTbl
    ) HD ON P.PersonID = HD.PersonID AND HD.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT PersonID, TitleName, PostionName,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PersonID ORDER BY NgayThayDoi DESC) as rn
        FROM HR_LichSuCongTacTbl
    ) LS ON P.PersonID = LS.PersonID AND LS.rn = 1

    WHERE
        -- Lọc theo Bộ phận
        (@PhongBan = N'' OR P.PhongBan LIKE N'%' + @PhongBan + N'%')

        -- Nếu @ToDate là NULL thì không lọc, ngược lại lọc theo ngày vào làm
        AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR ISNULL(P.NgayVaoLam, '1900-01-01') <= @ToDate)

        -- Nếu @FromDate là NULL thì không lọc, ngược lại lọc theo ngày nghỉ việc
        AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR P.NgayNghiViec IS NULL OR P.NgayNghiViec >= @FromDate)

    ORDER BY P.PhongBan, P.PersonName;
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_BaoCaoThongKeLuongStp]
    @PeriodID    nvarchar(10),
    @PhongBan    nvarchar(50) = N''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. Metadata cho framework Report

    -- 2. Truy vấn thống kê
    SELECT
        P.PhongBan              AS [Bộ phận],
        COUNT(DISTINCT P.PersonID) AS [Số nhân viên],

        -- Thống kê tài chính
        SUM(ISNULL(BL.TongThuNhap, 0)) AS [Tổng thu nhập],
        SUM(ISNULL(BL.TongThuNhap, 0) - ISNULL(BL.ThucLinh, 0)) AS [Tổng khấu trừ],
        SUM(ISNULL(BL.ThucLinh, 0))    AS [Tổng thực lĩnh],

        -- Phụ cấp
        SUM(ISNULL(BL.PhuCapAnTrua, 0) +
            ISNULL(BL.PhuCapXangXe, 0) +
            ISNULL(BL.PhuCapDienThoai, 0)) AS [Tổng phụ cấp]

    FROM HR_PersonTbl P
    LEFT JOIN HR_BangLuongTbl BL ON P.PersonID = BL.PersonID
                                 AND BL.PeriodID = @PeriodID


    WHERE
        -- Lọc theo Bộ phận
        (@PhongBan = N'' OR P.PhongBan LIKE N'%' + @PhongBan + N'%')

    GROUP BY P.PhongBan
    ORDER BY P.PhongBan;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_BaoHiem_PersonLookup]
(
    @BranchID NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @LoaiBaoHiem NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @DocumentID NVARCHAR(50) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @BranchID = ISNULL(@BranchID, '');
    SET @LoaiBaoHiem = ISNULL(@LoaiBaoHiem, '');
    SET @DocumentID = ISNULL(@DocumentID, '');

    DECLARE @LoaiHDFilter NVARCHAR(50) = '';

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Nếu không truyền BranchID / LoaiBaoHiem thì lấy từ master theo DocumentID
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @DocumentID <> ''
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1
            @BranchID = CASE
                            WHEN @BranchID = ''
                            THEN ISNULL(BranchID, '')
                            ELSE @BranchID
                        END,

            @LoaiBaoHiem = CASE
                                WHEN @LoaiBaoHiem = ''
                                THEN ISNULL(LoaiBaoHiem, '')
                                ELSE @LoaiBaoHiem
                            END
        FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl
        WHERE DocumentID = @DocumentID;
    END;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Lấy loại HD từ LoaiBaoHiem
    -- VD: BHXH_NVN => NVN
    -- VD: BHXH_NNN => NNN
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF UPPER(@LoaiBaoHiem) LIKE '%NNN%'
        SET @LoaiHDFilter = 'NNN';

    IF UPPER(@LoaiBaoHiem) LIKE '%NVN%'
        SET @LoaiHDFilter = 'NVN';

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Chưa chọn chi nhánh thì không xổ nhân viên
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @BranchID = ''
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS PersonID,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS PersonName,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS PhongBan,
            CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS MucDong,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS BranchID,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS ChucDanhChuyenMon,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS LoaiHD,
            N'' AS CanhBao
        WHERE 1 = 0;

        RETURN;
    END;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Lấy nhân viên theo chi nhánh master
    -- Lọc NVN / NNN dựa theo LoaiBaoHiem
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        P.PersonID,
        P.PersonName,
        P.PhongBan,
        ISNULL(BH.MucDong, 0) AS MucDong,
        P.BranchID,

        ISNULL(HDGN.ChucDanhChuyenMon, '') AS ChucDanhChuyenMon,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(HDGN.LoaiHD, '') LIKE '%NNN%' THEN 'NNN'
            ELSE 'NVN'
        END AS LoaiHD,

        CASE
            WHEN BH.PersonID IS NOT NULL
            THEN N'!!! ĐÃ CÓ BH TẠI KỲ: '
                 + CAST(BH.PeriodID AS VARCHAR(50))
                 + N' - Ngày CT: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), BH.DocumentDate, 103)
                 + N' (Chứng từ: ' + BH.DocumentID + N')'
            ELSE N''
        END AS CanhBao

    FROM dbo.HR_PersonTbl P

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP 1
            HD.PersonID,
            HD.LoaiHD,
            P.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
            HD.NgayKyHopDong,
            HD.NgayCoHieuLuc,
            HD.MaHopDong
        FROM dbo.HR_HopDongTbl HD
        WHERE HD.PersonID = P.PersonID
        ORDER BY
            ISNULL(HD.NgayCoHieuLuc, '19000101') DESC,
            ISNULL(HD.NgayKyHopDong, '19000101') DESC,
            HD.MaHopDong DESC
    ) HDGN

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP 1
            CT.PersonID,
            CT.MucDong,
            H.DocumentID,
            H.PeriodID,
            H.DocumentDate
        FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl CT
        INNER JOIN dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl H
            ON H.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID
        WHERE CT.PersonID = P.PersonID

          AND (
                @LoaiBaoHiem = ''
                OR H.LoaiBaoHiem = @LoaiBaoHiem
              )

          -- Không lấy chính chứng từ đang sửa để cảnh báo lại chính nó
          AND (
                @DocumentID = ''
                OR H.DocumentID <> @DocumentID
              )

        ORDER BY
            H.DocumentDate DESC,
            H.PeriodID DESC,
            H.DocumentID DESC
    ) BH

    WHERE P.BranchID = @BranchID

      AND
      (
            @LoaiHDFilter = ''

            OR
            (
                @LoaiHDFilter = 'NNN'
                AND ISNULL(HDGN.LoaiHD, '') LIKE '%NNN%'
            )

            OR
            (
                @LoaiHDFilter = 'NVN'
                AND ISNULL(HDGN.LoaiHD, '') NOT LIKE '%NNN%'
            )
      )

    ORDER BY P.PersonID DESC;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_BaoHiemReportStp]
    @Template   VARCHAR(100),
    @DocumentID NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- For auto Select report template:
    -- Set 'ReportName' as Template in return Datatable

    ;WITH BaoHiem AS
    (
        SELECT
            A.*,
            KyTruoc.DocumentID AS DocumentID_KyTruoc
        FROM HR_BaoHiemTbl A
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 B.DocumentID
            FROM HR_BaoHiemTbl B
            WHERE B.DocumentDate < A.DocumentDate
            ORDER BY B.PeriodID DESC, B.DocumentDate DESC, B.DocumentID DESC
        ) KyTruoc
        WHERE
        (
            ISNULL(@DocumentID, '') = ''
            OR A.DocumentID IN
            (
                SELECT value
                FROM SY_String2TableFnc(@DocumentID)
            )
        )
    ),
    CT AS
    (
        SELECT
            BHCT.*,
            P.PersonName,
            P.TitleName,
            P.PhongBan,
            P.ChucDanhChuyenMon
        FROM HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl BHCT
        LEFT JOIN HR_PersonTbl P ON BHCT.PersonID = P.PersonID
    ),
    CurrentPerson AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            A.DocumentID,
            CT.BranchID,
            CT.PersonID
        FROM BaoHiem A
        INNER JOIN CT ON A.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID
        WHERE ISNULL(CT.PersonID, '') <> ''
    ),
    PrevPerson AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            A.DocumentID,
            CT.BranchID,
            CT.PersonID
        FROM BaoHiem A
        INNER JOIN CT ON A.DocumentID_KyTruoc = CT.DocumentID
        WHERE ISNULL(CT.PersonID, '') <> ''
    ),
    SL_All AS
    (
        SELECT
            A.DocumentID,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM PrevPerson P
                WHERE P.DocumentID = A.DocumentID
            ) AS SoNhanVienKyTruoc_All,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM CurrentPerson C
                WHERE C.DocumentID = A.DocumentID
            ) AS SoNhanVienKyNay_All,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM CurrentPerson C
                WHERE C.DocumentID = A.DocumentID
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM PrevPerson P
                    WHERE P.DocumentID = C.DocumentID
                    AND P.PersonID = C.PersonID
                )
            ) AS SoTangBH_All,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM PrevPerson P
                WHERE P.DocumentID = A.DocumentID
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM CurrentPerson C
                    WHERE C.DocumentID = P.DocumentID
                    AND C.PersonID = P.PersonID
                )
            ) AS SoGiamBH_All
        FROM BaoHiem A
    ),
    BranchList AS
    (
        SELECT DocumentID, BranchID FROM CurrentPerson
        UNION
        SELECT DocumentID, BranchID FROM PrevPerson
    ),
    SL_ChiNhanh AS
    (
        SELECT
            BL.DocumentID,
            BL.BranchID,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM PrevPerson P
                WHERE P.DocumentID = BL.DocumentID
                AND P.BranchID = BL.BranchID
            ) AS SoNhanVienKyTruoc_ChiNhanh,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM CurrentPerson C
                WHERE C.DocumentID = BL.DocumentID
                AND C.BranchID = BL.BranchID
            ) AS SoNhanVienKyNay_ChiNhanh,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM CurrentPerson C
                WHERE C.DocumentID = BL.DocumentID
                AND C.BranchID = BL.BranchID
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM PrevPerson P
                    WHERE P.DocumentID = C.DocumentID
                    AND P.BranchID = C.BranchID
                    AND P.PersonID = C.PersonID
                )
            ) AS SoTangBH_ChiNhanh,

            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM PrevPerson P
                WHERE P.DocumentID = BL.DocumentID
                AND P.BranchID = BL.BranchID
                AND NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM CurrentPerson C
                    WHERE C.DocumentID = P.DocumentID
                    AND C.BranchID = P.BranchID
                    AND C.PersonID = P.PersonID
                )
            ) AS SoGiamBH_ChiNhanh
        FROM BranchList BL
        GROUP BY BL.DocumentID, BL.BranchID
    )

    SELECT
        @Template AS ReportName,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.DocumentID ORDER BY CT.BranchID, MaNVSort.TienToMaNV, MaNVSort.SoMaNV, CT.PersonID) AS STT_Document,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.DocumentID, CT.BranchID ORDER BY MaNVSort.TienToMaNV, MaNVSort.SoMaNV, CT.PersonID) AS STT_Branch,
        FORMAT(A.DocumentDate, 'MM/yyyy') AS Thang,
        A.DocumentID,
        A.DocumentID_KyTruoc,

        ISNULL(SLAll.SoNhanVienKyTruoc_All,0) AS SoNhanVienKyTruoc_All,
        ISNULL(SLAll.SoNhanVienKyNay_All,0) AS SoNhanVienKyNay_All,
        ISNULL(SLAll.SoNhanVienKyNay_All,0) - ISNULL(SLAll.SoNhanVienKyTruoc_All,0) AS ChenhLechSoLuongBH_All,
        ISNULL(SLAll.SoTangBH_All,0) AS SoTangBH_All,
        ISNULL(SLAll.SoGiamBH_All,0) AS SoGiamBH_All,

        ISNULL(SLBranch.SoNhanVienKyTruoc_ChiNhanh,0) AS SoNhanVienKyTruoc_ChiNhanh,
        ISNULL(SLBranch.SoNhanVienKyNay_ChiNhanh,0) AS SoNhanVienKyNay_ChiNhanh,
        ISNULL(SLBranch.SoNhanVienKyNay_ChiNhanh,0) - ISNULL(SLBranch.SoNhanVienKyTruoc_ChiNhanh,0) AS ChenhLechSoLuongBH_ChiNhanh,
        ISNULL(SLBranch.SoTangBH_ChiNhanh,0) AS SoTangBH_ChiNhanh,
        ISNULL(SLBranch.SoGiamBH_ChiNhanh,0) AS SoGiamBH_ChiNhanh,

        CT.PersonID,
        CT.PersonName,
        CT.ChucDanhChuyenMon,
        CT.BranchID,
        CT.TitleName,
        CT.PhongBan,
        CT.MucDong,
        CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,
        CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,
        CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,
        CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,
        CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,
        CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,

        ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,0) AS TongBHNLD,
        ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) AS TongBHNLDNN,
        ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,0) AS TongBHNSLD,
        ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) AS TongBHNSLDNNN,
        ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,0) AS TongBHAll,
        ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) AS TongBHAllNNN,

        -- Tổng toàn báo cáo
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0)) OVER() AS TongMucDong_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD, 0)) OVER() AS TongBHXHNLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD, 0)) OVER() AS TongBHYTNLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD, 0)) OVER() AS TongBHXHNSDLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD, 0)) OVER() AS TongBHYTNSDLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD, 0)) OVER() AS TongBHTNNLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD, 0)) OVER() AS TongBHTNNSDLD_All,

        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,0)) OVER() AS TongBHNLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,0)) OVER() AS TongBHNSLD_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,0)) OVER() AS TongBHAll_All,

        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0)) OVER() AS TongBHNLDNN_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0)) OVER() AS TongBHNSLDNNN_All,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0)) OVER() AS TongBHAllNNN_All,

        -- Tổng theo chi nhánh
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDong, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongMucDong_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHXHNLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHYTNLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHXHNSDLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHYTNSDLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHTNNLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHTNNSDLD_ChiNhanh,

        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHNLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHNSLD_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHTNNSDLD,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHAll_ChiNhanh,

        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHNLDNN_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHNSLDNNN_ChiNhanh,
        SUM(ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHXHNSDLD,0) + ISNULL(CT.MucDongBHYTNSDLD,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY CT.BranchID) AS TongBHAllNNN_ChiNhanh

    FROM BaoHiem A
    LEFT JOIN CT ON A.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID
    LEFT JOIN SL_All SLAll ON A.DocumentID = SLAll.DocumentID
    LEFT JOIN SL_ChiNhanh SLBranch ON A.DocumentID = SLBranch.DocumentID AND CT.BranchID = SLBranch.BranchID

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT LEN_NUM = PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', REVERSE(ISNULL(CT.PersonID,'')) + 'X') - 1
    ) X

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            TienToMaNV = LEFT(ISNULL(CT.PersonID,''), LEN(ISNULL(CT.PersonID,'')) - X.LEN_NUM),
            SoMaNV = TRY_CONVERT(INT, RIGHT(ISNULL(CT.PersonID,''), X.LEN_NUM))
    ) MaNVSort

    ORDER BY
        CT.BranchID,
        MaNVSort.TienToMaNV,
        MaNVSort.SoMaNV,
        CT.PersonID;
END;

objects.definition:
CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_Branch_GetByUserStp]
    @UserName NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @UserName = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@UserName, '')));

    DECLARE @BranchList NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- Lấy chuỗi chi nhánh của user
    SELECT TOP 1 @BranchList = ISNULL(U.BranchID, '')
    FROM dbo.SY_User U
    WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(U.UserName)) = @UserName;

    SET @BranchList = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@BranchList, '')));

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- NẾU @BranchList RỖNG -> LẤY TẤT CẢ CHI NHÁNH
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @BranchList = ''
    BEGIN
        SELECT BranchID, BranchName
        FROM dbo.CF_BranchTbl
        ORDER BY BranchName;
    END
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- NẾU CÓ CHI NHÁNH GÁN -> TÁCH CHUỖI NHƯ CŨ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) AS BranchID,
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(B.BranchName)), ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value))) AS BranchName
        FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(REPLACE(@BranchList, ',', ';')) S
        LEFT JOIN dbo.CF_BranchTbl B ON LTRIM(RTRIM(B.BranchID)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value))
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(S.value, ''))) <> ''
        ORDER BY BranchName;
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_Department_GetByUserStp]
    @UserName VARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @BranchString NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SELECT @BranchString = BranchID
    FROM SY_User
    WHERE UserName = @UserName;

    SELECT DISTINCT
        D.PhongBan,
        D.TenPhongBan,
        D.GhiChu,
        D.BranchID
    FROM HR_DepartmentListByBranchTbl D
    WHERE
        ISNULL(@BranchString, '') = ''
        OR EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(D.BranchID, ',') DB
            INNER JOIN STRING_SPLIT(@BranchString, ',') UB
                ON LTRIM(RTRIM(DB.value)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(UB.value))
        )
    ORDER BY D.TenPhongBan;
END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[HR_GetBrachIDByUserStp]
    @User nvarchar(100)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @BranchID nvarchar(1000);
    SELECT @BranchID = BranchID FROM SY_User WHERE UserName = @User;

    -- Sử dụng 1=1 để tạo khung, sau đó dùng AND bọc các điều kiện lại
    SELECT DISTINCT BranchID
    FROM HR_PersonTbl
    WHERE 1=1
    AND (
        (ISNULL(@BranchID, '') = '')
        OR
        (BranchID IN (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BranchID, ',')))
    )
END

objects.definition:
CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_HopDongLaoDongReportStp]
    @Template VARCHAR(100),
    @MaHopDong NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @Template NOT IN
    (
        'HR_HopDongLaoDongReport',
        'HR_HopDongLaoDong2Report',
        'HR_HopDongLaoDong3Report',
         'HR_HopDongLaoDong4Report'
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END;

    ;WITH CTE_HopDong AS
    (
        SELECT
            A.MaHopDong,
            CONVERT
            (
                BIGINT,
                ROUND(ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0), 0)
            ) AS MucDong
        FROM dbo.HR_HopDongTbl A
        WHERE
        (
            ISNULL(@MaHopDong, N'') = N''
            OR A.MaHopDong IN
            (
                SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
                FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(@MaHopDong)
            )
        )
    ),

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- TÁCH SỐ THÀNH TỪNG NHÓM 3 CHỮ SỐ
    -- Ví dụ: 15.000.000 => 15 | 000 | 000
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CTE_NhomSo AS
    (
        SELECT
            HD.MaHopDong,
            HD.MucDong,
            0 AS CapSo,
            CONVERT(INT, HD.MucDong % 1000) AS NhomSo,
            CONVERT(BIGINT, HD.MucDong / 1000) AS SoConLai
        FROM CTE_HopDong HD

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            NS.MaHopDong,
            NS.MucDong,
            NS.CapSo + 1,
            CONVERT(INT, NS.SoConLai % 1000) AS NhomSo,
            CONVERT(BIGINT, NS.SoConLai / 1000) AS SoConLai
        FROM CTE_NhomSo NS
        WHERE NS.SoConLai > 0
    ),

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- PHÂN TÍCH HÀNG TRĂM, CHỤC, ĐƠN VỊ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CTE_PhanTich AS
    (
        SELECT
            NS.MaHopDong,
            NS.MucDong,
            NS.CapSo,
            NS.NhomSo,
            NS.NhomSo / 100 AS HangTram,
            (NS.NhomSo % 100) / 10 AS HangChuc,
            NS.NhomSo % 10 AS HangDonVi
        FROM CTE_NhomSo NS
    ),

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ĐỌC TỪNG NHÓM SỐ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    CTE_DocNhom AS
    (
        SELECT
            PT.MaHopDong,
            PT.MucDong,
            PT.CapSo,
            PT.NhomSo,

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- ĐỌC TIẾNG VIỆT
            --------------------------------------------------------
            LTRIM
            (
                RTRIM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN PT.NhomSo = 0 THEN N''
                        ELSE
                            CASE
                                WHEN PT.HangTram > 0 THEN
                                    CASE PT.HangTram
                                        WHEN 1 THEN N'một'
                                        WHEN 2 THEN N'hai'
                                        WHEN 3 THEN N'ba'
                                        WHEN 4 THEN N'bốn'
                                        WHEN 5 THEN N'năm'
                                        WHEN 6 THEN N'sáu'
                                        WHEN 7 THEN N'bảy'
                                        WHEN 8 THEN N'tám'
                                        WHEN 9 THEN N'chín'
                                    END + N' trăm '
                                ELSE N''
                            END
                            +
                            CASE
                                WHEN PT.HangChuc > 1 THEN
                                    CASE PT.HangChuc
                                        WHEN 2 THEN N'hai'
                                        WHEN 3 THEN N'ba'
                                        WHEN 4 THEN N'bốn'
                                        WHEN 5 THEN N'năm'
                                        WHEN 6 THEN N'sáu'
                                        WHEN 7 THEN N'bảy'
                                        WHEN 8 THEN N'tám'
                                        WHEN 9 THEN N'chín'
                                    END + N' mươi '

                                WHEN PT.HangChuc = 1 THEN
                                    N'mười '

                                WHEN PT.HangChuc = 0
                                     AND PT.HangDonVi > 0
                                     AND PT.HangTram > 0 THEN
                                    N'lẻ '

                                ELSE N''
                            END
                            +
                            CASE
                                WHEN PT.HangDonVi = 0 THEN N''

                                WHEN PT.HangDonVi = 1
                                     AND PT.HangChuc > 1 THEN
                                    N'mốt'

                                WHEN PT.HangDonVi = 4
                                     AND PT.HangChuc > 1 THEN
                                    N'tư'

                                WHEN PT.HangDonVi = 5
                                     AND PT.HangChuc >= 1 THEN
                                    N'lăm'

                                ELSE
                                    CASE PT.HangDonVi
                                        WHEN 1 THEN N'một'
                                        WHEN 2 THEN N'hai'
                                        WHEN 3 THEN N'ba'
                                        WHEN 4 THEN N'bốn'
                                        WHEN 5 THEN N'năm'
                                        WHEN 6 THEN N'sáu'
                                        WHEN 7 THEN N'bảy'
                                        WHEN 8 THEN N'tám'
                                        WHEN 9 THEN N'chín'
                                        ELSE N''
                                    END
                            END
                    END
                )
            ) AS ChuTiengViet,

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- ĐỌC TIẾNG ANH
            --------------------------------------------------------
            LTRIM
            (
                RTRIM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN PT.NhomSo = 0 THEN N''
                        ELSE
                            CASE
                                WHEN PT.HangTram > 0 THEN
                                    CASE PT.HangTram
                                        WHEN 1 THEN N'one'
                                        WHEN 2 THEN N'two'
                                        WHEN 3 THEN N'three'
                                        WHEN 4 THEN N'four'
                                        WHEN 5 THEN N'five'
                                        WHEN 6 THEN N'six'
                                        WHEN 7 THEN N'seven'
                                        WHEN 8 THEN N'eight'
                                        WHEN 9 THEN N'nine'
                                    END + N' hundred '
                                ELSE N''
                            END
                            +
                            CASE
                                WHEN (PT.NhomSo % 100) BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN
                                    CASE PT.NhomSo % 100
                                        WHEN 10 THEN N'ten'
                                        WHEN 11 THEN N'eleven'
                                        WHEN 12 THEN N'twelve'
                                        WHEN 13 THEN N'thirteen'
                                        WHEN 14 THEN N'fourteen'
                                        WHEN 15 THEN N'fifteen'
                                        WHEN 16 THEN N'sixteen'
                                        WHEN 17 THEN N'seventeen'
                                        WHEN 18 THEN N'eighteen'
                                        WHEN 19 THEN N'nineteen'
                                    END

                                ELSE
                                    CASE
                                        WHEN PT.HangChuc >= 2 THEN
                                            CASE PT.HangChuc
                                                WHEN 2 THEN N'twenty'
                                                WHEN 3 THEN N'thirty'
                                                WHEN 4 THEN N'forty'
                                                WHEN 5 THEN N'fifty'
                                                WHEN 6 THEN N'sixty'
                                                WHEN 7 THEN N'seventy'
                                                WHEN 8 THEN N'eighty'
                                                WHEN 9 THEN N'ninety'
                                            END
                                            +
                                            CASE
                                                WHEN PT.HangDonVi > 0
                                                    THEN N' '
                                                ELSE N''
                                            END
                                        ELSE N''
                                    END
                                    +
                                    CASE
                                        WHEN PT.HangDonVi = 0 THEN N''
                                        ELSE
                                            CASE PT.HangDonVi
                                                WHEN 1 THEN N'one'
                                                WHEN 2 THEN N'two'
                                                WHEN 3 THEN N'three'
                                                WHEN 4 THEN N'four'
                                                WHEN 5 THEN N'five'
                                                WHEN 6 THEN N'six'
                                                WHEN 7 THEN N'seven'
                                                WHEN 8 THEN N'eight'
                                                WHEN 9 THEN N'nine'
                                            END
                                    END
                            END
                    END
                )
            ) AS ChuTiengAnh
        FROM CTE_PhanTich PT
    )

    SELECT
        A.*,
        P.*,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- NGÀY THÁNG
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        FORMAT(P.NgaySinh, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS NgaySinhFormat,
        FORMAT(A.NgayKyHopDong, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS NgayKyHopDongFormat,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MỨC ĐÓNG LẤY TỪ HR_HopDongTbl
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE FORMAT(A.MucDong, '#,##0')
        END AS MucDongFormat,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE N'VND'
        END AS DVTMucDong,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MỨC ĐÓNG BẰNG CHỮ TIẾNG VIỆT
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE
                UPPER(LEFT(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengViet, N''), 1))
                + SUBSTRING
                (
                    ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengViet, N''),
                    2,
                    LEN(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengViet, N''))
                )
                + N' đồng/tháng'
        END AS MucDongBangChu,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MỨC ĐÓNG BẰNG CHỮ TIẾNG ANH
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE
                UPPER(LEFT(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengAnh, N''), 1))
                + SUBSTRING
                (
                    ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengAnh, N''),
                    2,
                    LEN(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengAnh, N''))
                )
                + N' VND/month'
        END AS MucDongBangChuEN,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MỨC ĐÓNG ĐẦY ĐỦ TIẾNG VIỆT
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE
                FORMAT(A.MucDong, '#,##0')
                + N' VND (Bằng chữ: '
                + UPPER(LEFT(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengViet, N''), 1))
                + SUBSTRING
                (
                    ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengViet, N''),
                    2,
                    LEN(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengViet, N''))
                )
                + N' đồng/tháng)'
        END AS MucDongDayDuTiengViet,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- MỨC ĐÓNG ĐẦY ĐỦ TIẾNG ANH
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(A.MucDong, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE
                FORMAT(A.MucDong, '#,##0')
                + N' VND (In words: '
                + UPPER(LEFT(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengAnh, N''), 1))
                + SUBSTRING
                (
                    ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengAnh, N''),
                    2,
                    LEN(ISNULL(DOC.ChuTiengAnh, N''))
                )
                + N' VND/month)'
        END AS MucDongDayDuTiengAnh,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- TIỀN PHỤ CẤP
        -- NULL HOẶC 0 THÌ KHÔNG HIỆN SỐ TIỀN
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienCom, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE FORMAT(PC.TienCom, '#,##0')
        END AS TienCom,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienXangXe, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE FORMAT(PC.TienXangXe, '#,##0')
        END AS TienXangXe,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienDienThoai, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE FORMAT(PC.TienDienThoai, '#,##0')
        END AS TienDienThoai,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienNhaO, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE FORMAT(PC.TienNhaO, '#,##0')
        END AS TienNhaO,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienMaKup, 0) = 0 THEN N''
            ELSE FORMAT(PC.TienMaKup, '#,##0')
        END AS TienMaKup,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- DVT PHỤ CẤP
        --
        -- HR_HopDongLaoDongReport:
        --     Luôn hiện VND
        --
        -- HR_HopDongLaoDong2Report:
        --     > 50.000  => Đồng/tháng
        --     <= 50.000 => Đồng/ngày
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN @Template = 'HR_HopDongLaoDongReport'
                THEN N'VND'
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienCom, 0) > 50000
                THEN N'Đồng/tháng'
            ELSE N'Đồng/ngày'
        END AS DVTTienCom,

        CASE
            WHEN @Template = 'HR_HopDongLaoDongReport'
                THEN N'VND'
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienXangXe, 0) > 50000
                THEN N'Đồng/tháng'
            ELSE N'Đồng/ngày'
        END AS DVTTienXangXe,

        CASE
            WHEN @Template = 'HR_HopDongLaoDongReport'
                THEN N'VND'
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienDienThoai, 0) > 50000
                THEN N'Đồng/tháng'
            ELSE N'Đồng/ngày'
        END AS DVTTienDienThoai,

        CASE
            WHEN @Template = 'HR_HopDongLaoDongReport'
                THEN N'VND'
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienNhaO, 0) > 50000
                THEN N'Đồng/tháng'
            ELSE N'Đồng/ngày'
        END AS DVTTienNhaO,

        CASE
            WHEN @Template = 'HR_HopDongLaoDongReport'
                THEN N'VND'
            WHEN ISNULL(PC.TienMaKup, 0) > 50000
                THEN N'Đồng/tháng'
            ELSE N'Đồng/ngày'
        END AS DVTTienMaKup,

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- DVT LƯƠNG THỰC NHẬN
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        CASE
            WHEN @Template = 'HR_HopDongLaoDong2Report'
                THEN N'USD/month'
            ELSE N'Đồng/tháng'
        END AS DVTLuongThucNhan

    FROM dbo.HR_HopDongTbl A

    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = A.PersonID

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GHÉP CÁC NHÓM SỐ THÀNH CHỮ
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            STUFF
            (
                (
                    SELECT
                        N' '
                        + DN.ChuTiengViet
                        +
                        CASE DN.CapSo
                            WHEN 1 THEN N' nghìn'
                            WHEN 2 THEN N' triệu'
                            WHEN 3 THEN N' tỷ'
                            WHEN 4 THEN N' nghìn tỷ'
                            WHEN 5 THEN N' triệu tỷ'
                            ELSE N''
                        END
                    FROM CTE_DocNhom DN
                    WHERE DN.MaHopDong = A.MaHopDong
                      AND DN.NhomSo > 0
                    ORDER BY DN.CapSo DESC
                    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
                ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'),
                1,
                1,
                N''
            ) AS ChuTiengViet,

            STUFF
            (
                (
                    SELECT
                        N' '
                        + DN.ChuTiengAnh
                        +
                        CASE DN.CapSo
                            WHEN 1 THEN N' thousand'
                            WHEN 2 THEN N' million'
                            WHEN 3 THEN N' billion'
                            WHEN 4 THEN N' trillion'
                            WHEN 5 THEN N' quadrillion'
                            ELSE N''
                        END
                    FROM CTE_DocNhom DN
                    WHERE DN.MaHopDong = A.MaHopDong
                      AND DN.NhomSo > 0
                    ORDER BY DN.CapSo DESC
                    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
                ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'),
                1,
                1,
                N''
            ) AS ChuTiengAnh
    ) DOC

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- TỔNG HỢP PHỤ CẤP TỪ HR_HopDongDetailTbl
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN D.MaPhuCap IN
                    (
                        'Phu cap com',
                        'HOTROANCA',
                        'COM'
                    )
                    THEN ISNULL(D.TienPhuCap, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TienCom,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN D.MaPhuCap IN
                    (
                        'Phu cap xang xe',
                        'XANGXE'
                    )
                    THEN ISNULL(D.TienPhuCap, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TienXangXe,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN D.MaPhuCap IN
                    (
                        'Phu cap dien thoai',
                        'DIENTHOAI'
                    )
                    THEN ISNULL(D.TienPhuCap, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TienDienThoai,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN D.MaPhuCap IN
                    (
                        'Phu cap nha o',
                        'NHAO'
                    )
                    THEN ISNULL(D.TienPhuCap, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TienNhaO,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN D.MaPhuCap IN
                    (
                        'MAKUP',
                        'Phu cap makup'
                    )
                    THEN ISNULL(D.TienPhuCap, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TienMaKup

        FROM dbo.HR_HopDongDetailTbl D
        WHERE D.MaHopDong = A.MaHopDong
    ) PC

    WHERE
    (
        ISNULL(@MaHopDong, N'') = N''
        OR A.MaHopDong IN
        (
            SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
            FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc(@MaHopDong)
        )
    )

    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 20);
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_LayNhanVienMucDongTheoLoaiHDStp]
    @LoaiHD VARCHAR(10) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @LoaiHD = ISNULL(@LoaiHD, '');

    SELECT
        P.PersonID,
        P.PersonName,
        P.BranchID,

        HD.MaHopDong,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(HD.MaHopDong, '') LIKE '%NNN%' THEN 'NNN'
            ELSE 'NVN'
        END AS LoaiHD,

        ISNULL(BH.MucDong, 0) AS MucDong,
        ISNULL(BH.PeriodID, '') AS PeriodID,
        BH.DocumentDate,
        ISNULL(BH.DocumentID, '') AS DocumentID
    FROM HR_PersonTbl P

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP 1
            H.MaHopDong
        FROM HR_HopDongTbl H
        WHERE H.PersonID = P.PersonID
        ORDER BY
            H.NgayKyHopDong DESC,
            H.MaHopDong DESC
    ) HD

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP 1
            CT.MucDong,
            H.PeriodID,
            H.DocumentDate,
            H.DocumentID
        FROM HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl CT
        INNER JOIN HR_BaoHiemTbl H
            ON H.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID
        WHERE CT.PersonID = P.PersonID
        ORDER BY
            H.PeriodID DESC,
            H.DocumentDate DESC,
            H.DocumentID DESC
    ) BH

    WHERE
        (
            @LoaiHD = ''
            OR (@LoaiHD = 'NNN' AND ISNULL(HD.MaHopDong, '') LIKE '%NNN%')
            OR (@LoaiHD = 'NVN' AND ISNULL(HD.MaHopDong, '') NOT LIKE '%NNN%')
        )

    ORDER BY
        P.PersonID;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_PayRoll_Process_Stp]
    @PeriodID VARCHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    EXEC HR_TimeSheet_UpdateDailyStatus_Stp @Period = @PeriodID

    DECLARE @FromDate DATE, @ToDate DATE, @ToDateDT DATETIME, @NgayCongChuan DECIMAL(18,2) = 26.0;

    SELECT @FromDate = CAST(FromDate AS DATE), @ToDate = CAST(ToDate AS DATE), @ToDateDT = ToDate
    FROM dbo.SY_Period WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL BEGIN RAISERROR(N'Không tìm thấy kỳ lương.', 16, 1); RETURN; END;

    -- 1. Backup dữ liệu kỳ hiện tại để giữ các chỉnh sửa tay
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TmpBackup;

;WITH X AS
(
    SELECT PersonID,LuongTong,SoNguoiPhuThuoc,LuongCoBan,IsBH,IsHuuTri,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER
           (
               PARTITION BY PersonID
               ORDER BY DocumentDate DESC,DocumentID DESC
           ) AS RN
    FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl
    WHERE PeriodID=@PeriodID
)
SELECT PersonID,LuongTong,SoNguoiPhuThuoc,LuongCoBan,IsBH,IsHuuTri
INTO #TmpBackup
FROM X
WHERE RN=1;

    -- 2. Dọn dẹp bảng cũ
    DELETE D FROM dbo.HR_PayrollDetailTbl D INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H ON H.DocumentID = D.DocumentID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;
    DELETE FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl WHERE PeriodID = @PeriodID;

  -- 3. Insert với logic "Vét" dữ liệu kỳ gần nhất
    INSERT INTO dbo.HR_PayrollTbl (DocumentID, DocumentDate, PeriodID, PersonID, PersonName, MucDong, LuongTong, TongLuong, SoNguoiPhuThuoc, LuongCoBan, IsBH, IsHuuTri)
    SELECT
     NEWID(), @ToDateDT, @PeriodID, P.PersonID, P.PersonName,
        ISNULL(B.MucDong, 0),
        ISNULL(T.LuongTong, Old.LuongTong),
        0,
        ISNULL(T.SoNguoiPhuThuoc, ISNULL(Old.SoNguoiPhuThuoc, 0)),
        -- Ưu tiên: Sửa tay tháng này > Lấy từ tháng trước > Lấy mức đóng BH
        ISNULL(T.LuongCoBan, ISNULL(Old.LuongCoBan, ISNULL(B.MucDong, 0))),
        ISNULL(T.IsBH, ISNULL(Old.IsBH, 0)),
        ISNULL(T.IsHuuTri, ISNULL(Old.IsHuuTri, 0))
    FROM dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
    LEFT JOIN #TmpBackup T ON P.PersonID = T.PersonID
    OUTER APPLY (
        -- Dòng này sẽ tìm kỳ lương gần nhất ĐÃ CÓ LƯƠNG (>0) cho nhân viên đó
        SELECT TOP 1 LuongTong, SoNguoiPhuThuoc, LuongCoBan, IsBH, IsHuuTri
        FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl
        WHERE PersonID = P.PersonID
        AND PeriodID < @PeriodID
        AND LuongTong > 0
        ORDER BY PeriodID DESC
    ) Old
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT BH.PersonID, BH.MucDong
        FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl BH
        INNER JOIN (SELECT PersonID, MAX(DocumentID) as MaxDoc FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl GROUP BY PersonID) L
        ON BH.PersonID = L.PersonID AND BH.DocumentID = L.MaxDoc
    ) B ON P.PersonID = B.PersonID
   WHERE ISNULL(P.PersonID,'')<>''
  AND P.PersonStatus=4;
    -- 4. Bảng tạm tính
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ChamCong, #BaoHiemClean, #PhuCap, #LuongKhoan, #TmpPayrollDetail, #NhanVienPhanLoai;
SELECT TS.PersonID, SUM(ISNULL(TS.SoNgayDiLam, 0) + ISNULL(TS.NghiPhep, 0) + ISNULL(TS.SoNgayLe, 0)) AS TongNgayCongThucTe INTO #ChamCong FROM dbo.HR_TimeSheetTbl TS WHERE TS.PeriodID = @PeriodID GROUP BY TS.PersonID;

    ;WITH CTE_BH AS (SELECT BH.PersonID, (ISNULL(BH.MucDongBHXHNLD, 0) + ISNULL(BH.MucDongBHYTNLD, 0) + ISNULL(BH.MucDongBHTNNLD, 0)) AS TongBH, ISNULL(BH.MucDong, 0) AS MucDong, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BH.PersonID ORDER BY M.PeriodID DESC) AS RN FROM dbo.HR_BaoHiemChiTietTbl BH INNER JOIN dbo.HR_BaoHiemTbl M ON BH.DocumentID = M.DocumentID WHERE M.PeriodID <= @PeriodID)
    SELECT PersonID, TongBH, MucDong INTO #BaoHiemClean FROM CTE_BH WHERE RN = 1;

    SELECT PA.PersonID, SUM(CASE WHEN PA.MaPhuCap IN ('HOTROANCA', 'ANCA') THEN ISNULL(BPC.TienPhuCapThang, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS AnCa, SUM(CASE WHEN PA.MaPhuCap IN ('HOTROXANGXE', 'XANGXE') THEN ISNULL(BPC.TienPhuCapThang, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS XangXe, SUM(CASE WHEN PA.MaPhuCap IN ('HOTRODIENTHOAI', 'DIENTHOAI') THEN ISNULL(BPC.TienPhuCapThang, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS DienThoai INTO #PhuCap FROM dbo.HR_PersonAllowanceTbl PA LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_BangPhuCapTbl BPC ON BPC.MaPhuCap = PA.MaPhuCap GROUP BY PA.PersonID;
    SELECT LK.PersonID, SUM(ISNULL(LK.SoTienKhoan, 0)) AS SoTienKhoan INTO #LuongKhoan FROM dbo.HR_LuongKhoanTbl LK WHERE @ToDateDT BETWEEN LK.TuNgay AND ISNULL(LK.DenNgay, '2099-12-31') GROUP BY LK.PersonID;

    SELECT H.PersonID, H.DocumentID, CASE WHEN LK.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsKhoan
    INTO #NhanVienPhanLoai FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H LEFT JOIN #LuongKhoan LK ON H.PersonID = LK.PersonID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    CREATE TABLE #TmpPayrollDetail (DocumentID VARCHAR(50), Code INT, Mota NVARCHAR(255), SoTien DECIMAL(18,0));

    -- 5. Insert các khoản lương
INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail
    SELECT
        H.DocumentID,
        10,
        N'Lương cơ bản',
        CASE
            WHEN H.PersonID = 'VP016' THEN
                -- VP016: Dùng Lương khoán (LK.SoTienKhoan) để tính
                ROUND((ISNULL(LK.SoTienKhoan, 0) / @NgayCongChuan) * ISNULL(CC.TongNgayCongThucTe, 0), 0)
            ELSE
                -- Người khác: Dùng Lương cơ bản (H.LuongCoBan) bình thường
                ROUND((ISNULL(H.LuongCoBan, 0) / @NgayCongChuan) * ISNULL(CC.TongNgayCongThucTe, 0), 0)
        END
    FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H
    INNER JOIN #NhanVienPhanLoai NV ON H.DocumentID = NV.DocumentID
    LEFT JOIN #ChamCong CC ON CC.PersonID = H.PersonID
    LEFT JOIN #LuongKhoan LK ON LK.PersonID = H.PersonID -- Join để lấy lương khoán
    WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID
    AND (NV.IsKhoan = 0 OR H.PersonID In ('VP016', 'ÐD251'));

    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail SELECT H.DocumentID, 11, N'HOTROANCA', ISNULL(PC.AnCa, 0) FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H INNER JOIN #PhuCap PC ON PC.PersonID = H.PersonID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;
INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail SELECT H.DocumentID, 12, N'HOTROXANGXE', ISNULL(PC.XangXe, 0) FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H INNER JOIN #PhuCap PC ON PC.PersonID = H.PersonID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;
    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail SELECT H.DocumentID, 13, N'HOTRODIENTHOAI', ISNULL(PC.DienThoai, 0) FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H INNER JOIN #PhuCap PC ON PC.PersonID = H.PersonID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;
    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail SELECT H.DocumentID, 14, N'Lương khoán', ISNULL(LK.SoTienKhoan, 0) FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H INNER JOIN #LuongKhoan LK ON LK.PersonID = H.PersonID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;
    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail SELECT H.DocumentID, 30, N'BHXH, BHYT, BHTN', CASE WHEN H.IsBH = 1 THEN ISNULL(B.TongBH, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H LEFT JOIN #BaoHiemClean B ON B.PersonID = H.PersonID WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail
    SELECT H.DocumentID, 44, N'Thưởng hiệu suất', ROUND(((ISNULL(H.LuongTong, 0) - (ISNULL(B.MucDong, 0) + ISNULL(PC.AnCa, 0) + ISNULL(PC.XangXe, 0) + ISNULL(PC.DienThoai, 0))) * ISNULL(CC.TongNgayCongThucTe, 0)) / @NgayCongChuan, -3)
    FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H INNER JOIN #NhanVienPhanLoai NV ON H.DocumentID = NV.DocumentID LEFT JOIN #ChamCong CC ON CC.PersonID = H.PersonID LEFT JOIN #BaoHiemClean B ON B.PersonID = H.PersonID LEFT JOIN #PhuCap PC ON PC.PersonID = H.PersonID AND (NV.IsKhoan = 0 OR H.PersonID IN ('VP016', 'ÐD251'));

    -- 6. Tính thuế
    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail
    SELECT T.DocumentID, 20, N'Tổng thu nhập', SUM(CASE WHEN Code = 14 AND H.PersonID = 'VP016'  THEN 0 ELSE SoTien END)
    FROM #TmpPayrollDetail T INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H ON T.DocumentID = H.DocumentID WHERE Code IN (10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 44) GROUP BY T.DocumentID;

    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail
    SELECT H.DocumentID, 50, N'Thu nhập chịu thuế',
    CASE WHEN H.PersonID In ('VP016','ÐD251') THEN ISNULL(T10.SoTien, 0)
         ELSE ISNULL(LK.SoTienKhoan, (ISNULL(T10.SoTien, 0) + ISNULL(T12.SoTien, 0) + ISNULL(T13.SoTien, 0) + ISNULL(T44.SoTien, 0) + ISNULL(T14.SoTien, 0))) END
    FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H LEFT JOIN #LuongKhoan LK ON LK.PersonID = H.PersonID LEFT JOIN #TmpPayrollDetail T10 ON T10.DocumentID = H.DocumentID AND T10.Code = 10
    LEFT JOIN #TmpPayrollDetail T12 ON T12.DocumentID = H.DocumentID AND T12.Code = 12 LEFT JOIN #TmpPayrollDetail T13 ON T13.DocumentID = H.DocumentID AND T13.Code = 13
    LEFT JOIN #TmpPayrollDetail T44 ON T44.DocumentID = H.DocumentID AND T44.Code = 44 LEFT JOIN #TmpPayrollDetail T14 ON T14.DocumentID = H.DocumentID AND T14.Code = 14 WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;

    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail
    SELECT T50.DocumentID, 60, N'Thu nhập tính thuế', CASE WHEN H.IsBH = 0 OR H.IsHuuTri = 1 THEN ISNULL(T50.SoTien, 0) WHEN H.SoNguoiPhuThuoc = 0 AND T50.SoTien > 15500000 THEN T50.SoTien - 15500000 WHEN H.SoNguoiPhuThuoc > 0 AND T50.SoTien > 21700000 THEN T50.SoTien - 21700000 ELSE 0 END
FROM #TmpPayrollDetail T50 INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H ON H.DocumentID = T50.DocumentID WHERE T50.Code = 50;

    INSERT INTO #TmpPayrollDetail
    SELECT T60.DocumentID, 31, N'Thuế TNCN', CASE WHEN H.IsBH = 0 OR H.IsHuuTri = 1 THEN ROUND(ISNULL(T60.SoTien, 0) * 0.1, 0) ELSE ROUND(ISNULL(T60.SoTien, 0) * 0.05, 0) END
    FROM #TmpPayrollDetail T60 INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H ON H.DocumentID = T60.DocumentID WHERE T60.Code = 60;

    UPDATE H SET H.TongLuong = ISNULL(T20.SoTien, 0) - ISNULL(H.TienBuTru, 0) FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl H LEFT JOIN #TmpPayrollDetail T20 ON T20.DocumentID = H.DocumentID AND T20.Code = 20 WHERE H.PeriodID = @PeriodID;
    INSERT INTO dbo.HR_PayrollDetailTbl (UserAutoID, DocumentID, Code, Mota, SoTien, Notes) SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), NEWID()), T.DocumentID, T.Code, T.Mota, T.SoTien, '' FROM #TmpPayrollDetail T;

    PRINT N'Xong!';
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_PayrollPersonReportStp]
    @PeriodID VARCHAR(10),
    @PersonID1 NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @BranchID1 VARCHAR(MAX) = '',
    @User VARCHAR(50) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. LẤY DANH SÁCH NHÂN VIÊN USER ĐƯỢC PHÉP XEM
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Person1;

    /*
        Số lượng, thứ tự và kiểu dữ liệu các cột phải khớp với
        kết quả trả về của HR_Person_GetListByUserBranchStp.
    */
    CREATE TABLE #Person1
    (
        PersonID   NVARCHAR(50),
        PersonName NVARCHAR(250),
        BranchID   NVARCHAR(100),
        PhongBan   NVARCHAR(250)
    );

    INSERT INTO #Person1
    (
        PersonID,
        PersonName,
        BranchID,
        PhongBan
    )
    EXEC dbo.HR_Person_GetListByUserBranchStp

    @UserName = @User;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. DANH SÁCH CHI NHÁNH ĐƯỢC CHỌN
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FinalBranch;

    CREATE TABLE #FinalBranch
    (
        BranchID NVARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY
    );

    IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@BranchID1, ''))), '') IS NOT NULL
       AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@BranchID1))) <> 'ALL'
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID)
        SELECT DISTINCT
            LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Value))
        FROM dbo.SY_String2TableFnc
        (
            REPLACE(@BranchID1, ',', ';')
        ) S
        INNER JOIN #Person1 P1
            ON LTRIM(RTRIM(P1.BranchID)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Value))
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Value)), '') IS NOT NULL;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #FinalBranch (BranchID)
        SELECT DISTINCT
            LTRIM(RTRIM(BranchID))
        FROM #Person1
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(BranchID)), '') IS NOT NULL;
    END;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. TỔNG HỢP CHI TIẾT LƯƠNG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH PayrollSummary AS
    (
        SELECT
            DocumentID,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN Code LIKE 'A%' THEN ISNULL(SoTien, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TongThuNhap,

            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN Code LIKE 'B%' THEN ABS(ISNULL(SoTien, 0))
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS TongKhauTru,

            SUM(ISNULL(SoTien, 0)) AS ThucLinh
        FROM dbo.HR_PayrollDetailTbl
        GROUP BY DocumentID
    )
    SELECT
        A.DocumentID,
        A.PeriodID,
        A.PersonID,
        A.PersonName,
        A.TongLuong,
        A.DocumentDate,

        B.Code,
        B.Mota,
        B.SoTien,
        B.Notes,

        P.PhongBan,
        P.TitleName AS ChucVu,
        P.NgayVaoLam,
        P.BankAccountNo AS TKNganHang,
        P.BankName AS TenNganHang,
        P.CMND AS CCCD,

        ABS(ISNULL(B.SoTien, 0)) AS SoTienAbs,

        CASE
            WHEN B.Code LIKE 'A%' THEN N'A. CÁC KHOẢN THU NHẬP'
            WHEN B.Code LIKE 'B%' THEN N'B. CÁC KHOẢN KHẤU TRỪ'
            ELSE N'KHÁC'
        END AS NhomKhoan,

        CASE
            WHEN B.Code LIKE 'A%' THEN 1
            WHEN B.Code LIKE 'B%' THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS NhomSTT,

        ISNULL(PS.TongThuNhap, 0) AS TongThuNhap,
        ISNULL(PS.TongKhauTru, 0) AS TongKhauTru,
        ISNULL(PS.ThucLinh, 0) AS ThucLinh

    FROM dbo.HR_PayrollTbl A

    INNER JOIN dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
        ON P.PersonID = A.PersonID

    -- Nhân viên phải nằm trong danh sách mà user được xem
    INNER JOIN
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT PersonID, BranchID
        FROM #Person1
    ) P1
        ON P1.PersonID = A.PersonID
       AND LTRIM(RTRIM(P1.BranchID)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(P.BranchID))

    -- Chi nhánh phải nằm trong danh sách được chọn
    INNER JOIN #FinalBranch FB
        ON FB.BranchID = LTRIM(RTRIM(P.BranchID))

    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_PayrollDetailTbl B
        ON B.DocumentID = A.DocumentID

    LEFT JOIN PayrollSummary PS
        ON PS.DocumentID = A.DocumentID

    WHERE A.PeriodID = @PeriodID
      AND
      (
          NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@PersonID1, ''))), '') IS NULL
          OR A.PersonID = @PersonID1
      )

    ORDER BY
        A.PersonID,
        NhomSTT,
        B.Code;
END;

CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_Person_GetListByBranchStp]
    @ListBranchID NVARCHAR(MAX) -- Ví dụ truyền vào: N'COBI, DONGDU' hoặc ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. Tạo bảng tạm chứa danh sách chi nhánh được chọn
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BranchFilter;
    CREATE TABLE #BranchFilter (BranchID NVARCHAR(100));

    -- Nếu chuỗi không rỗng, tách chuỗi và thêm vào bảng tạm
    IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@ListBranchID, ''))) <> ''
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #BranchFilter (BranchID)
        SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@ListBranchID, ',');
    END

    -- 2. Truy vấn dữ liệu
    -- Điều kiện: Lấy NV có status = 4
    -- VÀ (Nếu bảng tạm rỗng thì lấy hết, nếu có dữ liệu thì chỉ lấy chi nhánh trong bảng)
    SELECT TOP 1000 * FROM dbo.HR_PersonView
    WHERE PersonStatus = 4
      AND (
            NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #BranchFilter)
            OR BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM #BranchFilter)
          );
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[HR_Person_GetListByUserBranchStp]
    @UserName VARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @BranchString NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SELECT @BranchString = BranchID
    FROM dbo.SY_User
    WHERE UserName = @UserName;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UserBranch;

    CREATE TABLE #UserBranch
    (
        BranchID NVARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY
    );

    IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@BranchString, ''))) <> ''
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #UserBranch (BranchID)
        SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BranchString, ',')
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) <> '';
    END;

    SELECT
        P.*
    FROM dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
    WHERE
        P.PersonStatus = 4
        AND
        (
            -- User không được gán chi nhánh thì lấy toàn bộ
            NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM #UserBranch
            )

            OR

            -- User có gán chi nhánh thì chỉ lấy nhân sự thuộc chi nhánh đó
            EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM #UserBranch UB
                WHERE UB.BranchID = P.BranchID
            )
        )
    ORDER BY
        P.BranchID,
        P.PersonID;
END;

CREATE procedure [dbo].[HR_Person_GetListByUserStp]  --HR_Person_GetListByUserStp 'testweb'
    @UserName VARCHAR(50) -- Tên đăng nhập của người dùng
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. Lấy danh sách các chi nhánh mà User này được phép truy cập
    -- Giả sử hệ thống dùng bảng tạm hoặc table-valued function này
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UserAllowedBranch;
    CREATE TABLE #UserAllowedBranch (BranchID NVARCHAR(100));

    INSERT INTO #UserAllowedBranch (BranchID)
    EXEC dbo.HR_Branch_GetByUserStp @UserName = @UserName;

    -- 2. Truy vấn danh sách nhân viên theo chi nhánh đã lọc
    -- Sử dụng INNER JOIN để chỉ lấy nhân viên thuộc chi nhánh được phép
    SELECT
        P.PersonID,
        P.PersonName,
        P.PhongBan,
        P.BranchID,
        B.BranchName
    FROM dbo.HR_PersonTbl P
    INNER JOIN #UserAllowedBranch UA ON P.BranchID = UA.BranchID
    LEFT JOIN dbo.HR_BranchTbl B ON P.BranchID = B.BranchID
    WHERE P.PersonStatus = 4 -- Lọc trạng thái nhân viên đang làm việc (nếu cần)
    ORDER BY P.BranchID, P.PersonID;
END

CREATE PROC [dbo].[HR_SapCaChiNhanh_Process_Stp]
(
    @SapCaID VARCHAR(30)
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET DATEFIRST 1;

    DECLARE
        @FromDate DATE,
        @ToDate DATE,
        @Msg NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SELECT
        @FromDate = TuNgay,
        @ToDate   = DenNgay
    FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhTbl
    WHERE SapCaID = @SapCaID;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        RETURN;

    ;WITH Ngay AS
    (
        SELECT @FromDate AS NgayLamViec
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATEADD(DAY,1,NgayLamViec)
        FROM Ngay
        WHERE NgayLamViec < @ToDate
    )
    SELECT
        @Msg =
        STUFF
        (
        (
            SELECT
                CHAR(13)+CHAR(10)
                + N'- '
                + CT.PersonID
                + N' - '
                + ISNULL(P.PersonName,N'')
                + N' | Ngày: '
                + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CT.NgayLamViec,103)
                + N' | Ca: '
                + ISNULL(S.ShiftName,S.ShiftID)
                + N' | Bảng ca: '
                + CT.SapCaID
            FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl CT
            INNER JOIN HR_SapCaNhanVienChiNhanhTbl NV
                ON NV.PersonID = CT.PersonID
                AND NV.SapCaID = CT.SapCaID
            INNER JOIN Ngay N
                ON N.NgayLamViec = CT.NgayLamViec
            LEFT JOIN HR_PersonTbl P
                ON P.PersonID = CT.PersonID
            LEFT JOIN HR_ShiftListCNTbl S
                ON S.ShiftID = CT.ShiftID
                AND S.BranchID = NV.BranchID
            WHERE NV.SapCaID = @SapCaID
              AND CT.SapCaID <> @SapCaID
            FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE
        ).value('.','nvarchar(max)')
        ,1,2,'')
    OPTION(MAXRECURSION 32767);

    IF ISNULL(@Msg,'') <> ''
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Các nhân viên sau đã được sắp ca:%s',16,1,@Msg);
        RETURN;
    END

    DELETE
    FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl
    WHERE SapCaID = @SapCaID;

    ;WITH Ngay AS
    (
        SELECT @FromDate AS NgayLamViec

        UNION ALL

        SELECT DATEADD(DAY,1,NgayLamViec)
        FROM Ngay
        WHERE NgayLamViec < @ToDate
    )

    INSERT INTO HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl
    (
        UserAutoID,
        SapCaID,
        PersonID,
        NgayLamViec,
        TrangThaiThucTe,
        ShiftID,
        GhiChu,
           HinhThucNghi
    )
    SELECT
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Ngay.NgayLamViec,112) + NV.PersonID,

        NV.SapCaID,

        NV.PersonID,

        Ngay.NgayLamViec,

        CASE
            WHEN HT.TenHinhThucNghi IS NOT NULL THEN HT.TenHinhThucNghi
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=1 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu2=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=2 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu3=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=3 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu4=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=4 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu5=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=5 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu6=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=6 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu7=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
             WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)=7 THEN CASE WHEN NV.ChuNhat=1 THEN N'Nghỉ Ca' ELSE N'Làm việc' END
        END,

        CASE DATEPART(WEEKDAY,Ngay.NgayLamViec)
             WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu2=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
             WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu3=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
             WHEN 3 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu4=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
             WHEN 4 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu5=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
             WHEN 5 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu6=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
             WHEN 6 THEN CASE WHEN NV.Thu7=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
             WHEN 7 THEN CASE WHEN NV.ChuNhat=1 THEN NULL ELSE NV.ShiftID END
        END,

        NULL,
        Nghi.HinhThucNghi

    FROM Ngay
    CROSS JOIN HR_SapCaNhanVienChiNhanhTbl NV
    LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        NP.PersonID,
        CT.HinhThucNghi,
        CAST(CT.NghiTuNgay AS DATE) AS NghiTuNgay,
        CAST(CT.DenNgay AS DATE) AS DenNgay
    FROM HR_NghiPhepTbl NP
    INNER JOIN HR_NghiPhepDetailTbl CT
        ON NP.DocumentID = CT.DocumentID
    WHERE NP.StatusID = 8
      AND ISNULL(NP.IsXinHuy,0) = 0
) Nghi
LEFT JOIN HR_HinhThucNghiListTbl HT ON HT.HinhThucNghi=Nghi.HinhThucNghi
ON Nghi.PersonID = NV.PersonID
AND Ngay.NgayLamViec >= Nghi.NghiTuNgay
AND Ngay.NgayLamViec < Nghi.DenNgay
    WHERE NV.SapCaID = @SapCaID

    OPTION(MAXRECURSION 32767);


/* ===== UPDATE NGƯỢC BẢNG NHÂN VIÊN CHI NHÁNH THEO CHI TIẾT SẮP CA ===== */
UPDATE NV
SET
    Thu2    = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=1 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.Thu2 END,
    Thu3    = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=2 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.Thu3 END,
    Thu4    = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=3 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.Thu4 END,
    Thu5    = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=4 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.Thu5 END,
    Thu6    = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=5 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.Thu6 END,
    Thu7    = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=6 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.Thu7 END,
    ChuNhat = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_SapCaChiNhanhChiTietTbl C WHERE C.SapCaID=NV.SapCaID AND C.PersonID=NV.PersonID AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY,C.NgayLamViec)=7 AND ISNULL(C.HinhThucNghi,'')<>'') THEN 1 ELSE NV.ChuNhat END
FROM HR_SapCaNhanVienChiNhanhTbl NV
WHERE NV.SapCaID=@SapCaID;

END
